statement.title: A dialogue between matter and void. Each piece is a curated artifact designed for the architectural home.
statement.body: In an era of disposable luxury, ARTWORK proposes permanence. Our materials are sourced with ethical precision, crafted by generational artisans.

hero.title: The Art of Living Interrupted.
hero.body: We don't just furnish spaces; we construct pauses. ARTWORK is an exploration of the physical boundary where discipline meets desire.

sections.title: A curation of disciplined forms and unapologetic craftsmanship.
sections.body: True luxury is not loud. It is the silent weight of a solid walnut frame, the grain that tells a century-old story, and the precision of a joint that feels seamless to the touch.

sections.title: From Armenian Roots to Global Modernity.
sections.body: Born from a lineage of Armenian master woodworkers, ARTWORK carries the soul of ancient craftsmanship into the digital age.
